stories.title: Argentina is back in the World Cup final after a thrilling semifinal win over England
stories.summary: Argentina survived another heart-stopping match when it scored two late goals to topple England and extend the Three Lions' six-decade-long wait for another World Cup trophy.

stories.title: Hitting it by ear: How beep baseball brings the diamond to visually impaired athletes
stories.summary: "Beep" baseball uses sound to guide visually impaired players to hit the ball and run the bases.

stories.title: Fear and hope in Utah in the shadow of America's largest wildfire
stories.summary: People in Monticello, Utah have been tense and preparing to evacuate since shortly after the Babylon fire started June 26th

stories.title: Man killed by ICE in Maine remembered as a father and hard worker
stories.summary: The man killed by an ICE in Southern Maine this week was a young father, husband and part of small community of immigrants who relied on their neighbors to get by.

stories.title: Too weak to advocate for herself, a young woman is saved by a nun
stories.summary: When Solitaire Miles was 18, she had a stroke. When she got to the hospital, doctors and nurses accused her of being on drugs. Then, her unsung hero arrived and ensured she got the care she needed.

stories.title: When life is chaos, make art
stories.summary: Artists create, even during times of chaos. In response to Trump policies and ICE's incursions, arts organizations are leaning in to new ways of fostering community in ways large and small.
